HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

14. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
